definition: having no world of my own to go into, so I need other people's

settled:
Other people can retreat inward for the same mix of the familiar and the new. I have nothing to retreat to.

Other autistic people get escape, decompression and stimulation out of a world of their own. I get all three out of other people's, through books, games and shows.

So running out of content is a real state rather than boredom, and an aversive one. The channel those three arrive on has closed.
